proof_body:
by
  intro a b hab
  have ha : a ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul hab.ne'
  have hb : b ≠ 0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul hab.ne'
  have key : a / b + b / a - 2 = (a - b) ^ 2 / (a * b) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  refine ⟨?_, ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩⟩
  · have h1 := div_nonneg (sq_nonneg (a - b)) hab.le
    linarith
  · have h0 : (a - b) ^ 2 / (a * b) = 0 := by
      rw [← key]
      linarith
    have h1 : (a - b) ^ 2 = 0 := by
      rcases div_eq_zero_iff.1 h0 with h1 | h1
      · exact h1
      · exact absurd h1 hab.ne'
    have h2 : a - b = 0 := (pow_eq_zero_iff (by norm_num)).1 h1
    linarith
  · subst h
    field_simp
    norm_num
target_source: ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 < a * b → 2 ≤ a / b + b / a ∧ (a / b + b / a = 2 ↔ a = b)
